in_hebrew.name: אבריציו
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Fabrizio is derived from the Latin name Fabrizzio, which means 'man of Jupiter'. In Hebrew, it can be translated as 'אבריציו' (Avritzio), which preserves the meaning of the original name.

in_greek.name: Φαβρίζιος
in_greek.long_meaning: Although the name Fabrizio is of Latin origin, it can be traced back to ancient Greek as well. In Greek, it is translated as Φαβρίζιος (Phabrizios), which means 'man of Bacchus'. This is due to the influence of the Roman gods on Greek mythology.

in_latin.name: Fabrizius
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Fabrizio is of Latin origin and means 'man of Jupiter'. This is a reference to the Roman god Jupiter, who was considered the king of the gods in the ancient Roman pantheon.
